capabilities.name: blog.post.view
capabilities.label: Read posts
capabilities.description: Read public posts and posts shared with signed-in Blog users. This does not allow editing or publishing.

capabilities.name: blog.post.create
capabilities.label: Write posts
capabilities.description: Create posts and edit or remove your own posts. New posts stay members-only unless a moderator publishes them.

capabilities.name: blog.post.moderate
capabilities.label: Manage all posts
capabilities.description: Edit, publish, hide or remove any person's post.

capabilities.name: blog.comment.create
capabilities.label: Comment on posts
capabilities.description: Add comments to posts that the person can read and remove their own comments.

capabilities.name: blog.gallery.view
capabilities.label: View galleries
capabilities.description: Open public galleries and galleries available to signed-in Blog users. Unpublished photos remain hidden.

capabilities.name: blog.gallery.create
capabilities.label: Upload to galleries
capabilities.description: Create galleries and upload photos. Uploaded photos wait for publication.

capabilities.name: blog.gallery.moderate
capabilities.label: Manage every gallery
capabilities.description: Rename, publish, hide and remove galleries or photos belonging to anyone.

capabilities.name: blog.story.create
capabilities.label: Post stories
capabilities.description: Publish short-lived photo or video stories from the person's own account.

capabilities.name: blog.notice.moderate
capabilities.label: Publish notices
capabilities.description: Create, change and remove notices shown across Blog.
